title: A Theory of Everything - Updated Research Corpus: Exact Mode Sums, Coupled Vacuum, Radion Mixing and Finite-Momentum Stability (2026-10-22)
description:
A Theory of Everything - Updated Research Corpus (edition 2026.10.22), prepared for Christopher Michael Baird / ZoraASI.

The 9,447-page reading edition contains six new editorial pages, nine recent theory and continuation notes (90 pages), the complete 9,252-page public edition previously deposited as DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23524358, and 42 byte-distinct computational mathematics/status reports (99 pages). These 51 additional source PDFs span 21-22 October 2026. Historical revisions and status-board repetition remain clearly identified.

The archive preserves the entire previous public ZIP, all seven identified MQGT-SCF research prereleases through the finite-momentum pole release at commit c0e36ad13a8da384c2b8c25463dae01022c12e46, their original assets and caveats, the two intervening geometric weak/neutral-Higgs PDF notes, available mathematics sidecars, catalogues, physical page maps, source provenance, SHA-256 manifests and portable assembly/verification tools. Standalone code bundles for the two intervening notes were not located. Scope is the documented published and local sources, not every cloud draft or repository.

The update explicitly records the scientific progression from local scalar estimates through exact mode sums, tuned restricted vacua and two-derivative radion mixing to the finite-momentum stability obstruction. The minimal retained action has tachyonic poles with negative residues and non-real poles under its stated direct analytic continuation. Positive infrared kinetic matrices and timelike residues do not establish a stable vacuum. Full compactification, omitted modes, causal quantum continuation and matching remain unresolved. No measured coupling is fitted; the measured fine-structure constant remains unexplained.

The earlier public edition retains Jennifer Lorraine Nielsen's separately authored, licensed 116-page preprint (DOI 10.20944/preprints202604.0315.v5, CC BY 4.0). The private 240-page manuscript and personal study guide remain excluded. The 21 October continuation separately attributes Pedalino et al. public data (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17502163); its optional EOS ancillary table is not redistributed. Inclusion does not imply collaborators' coauthorship of all works or endorsement of the compilation. All component-specific licenses and notices remain in force.

This is an AI-assisted archival research update, not a completed or experimentally validated Theory of Everything. Packaging checks concern file integrity, page fidelity and reproducibility apparatus; scientific calculations are not rerun as part of assembly. Recorded tests remain conditional computational evidence, not physical validation or external peer review.
